## Goal

Ensure WordPress release quality through automated validation of code quality, testing, documentation, and security compliance.

## Scope

- Code quality checks
- Test coverage validation
- Documentation verification
- Security compliance scanning
- Approval workflows
- Rollback automation
- Release notes generation

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All validation checks working
- [ ] Workflow approval functional
- [ ] Rollback procedures tested
- [ ] Release notes generated accurately
- [ ] Integration with CI/CD complete
- [ ] Documentation clear
- [ ] Stakeholder approval obtained
